EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 Land Ministry Ref. No.: LD/05/2009/HW/233. My No.: 4/2/1/4/42.

I, hereby give Notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required to construct a sub road of Mawanella. Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired: Situation:- Situated in the Grama Niladhari Divisions of Mawana and Rankothdiwela in the minor division of Egodapatha and Thanipperu pattuwa in Medapattuwa in the Divisional Secretary Division of Mawanella in Kegalle District in Sabaragamuwa Province. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/Lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by Agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Mawanella on 11th March 2015 at 10.a. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 02nd day of March 2015 the nature of their interests in the land. The particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. M. M. P. PRIYANGANI PETANGODA, Divisional Secretary, Mawanella.
